hits.title: Continent 8 Welcomes Mike Small as CEO, Michael Tobin Becomes Chair
hits.snippet: According to Continent 8’s announcement, Tobin will not be leaving the company, but transitioning to chair. At the same time, Mike Small has been appointed as the business’ new chief executive officer, effective July 15, 2026. Before joining Continent 8, he served as president of Akkodis North America and US Country president of The Adecco Group. hits.snippet: as chief executive, bringing an end to founder Michael Tobin’s 28-year spell in charge. Small assumed the role on 15 July 2026, with Tobin transitioning to chairman after leading the business since its launch in 1998. The leadership change comes as Continent 8 looks to expand its global footprint and strengthen its portfolio across cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure and AI-enabled technology services. Most recently, he served as president of Akkodis North America and US country president of The Adecco Group, where he oversaw technology, engineering and managed services businesses while leading the company’s AI strategy. [...] He has also held senior leadership positions at IBM, Hewlett Packard, Capgemini, Sitel Group and VXI & SYMBIO Global Solutions. Over the past year, Small has worked with Continent 8 as a strategic board advisor, supporting the executive leadership team ahead of the succession.
